entries.pattern: Config error in AdvancedShowers: same research view coords and tab as VCE_StewCooking: 2, 0(RUT_Tree_Hearth)
entries.note: OUR ResearchRetag consolidation (RESEARCH_TREE_TABS_1) put two third-party research projects in the same tab. A fix was already committed (14cf4186, RESEARCH_TAB_VIEWCOORD_COLLISION_1, deployed 2026-09-05T01:37 local, forcing AdvancedShowers's researchViewX/Y to 2,1) - but all three logs this baseline is measured from were captured HOURS after that deploy and still show the exact pre-fix (2,0) pair. EXHAUSTIVELY CHECKED (2026-09-06): grepped every one of the 596 active mods' own directories (local Mods AND Steam Workshop content, via manifest.json's rootDir per mod, not just the local Mods folder) for 'AdvancedShowers' - the ONLY hits are Dubs Bad Hygiene Lite's own raw declaration (researchViewX=5, researchViewY=0.5) and our own two ResearchRetag files. No third-party XML patches this def at all, so the original theory of an unidentified mod's compatibility patch clobbering it is RULED OUT. Read the mechanism instead: Verse.ResearchProjectDef.ConfigErrors() compares the ResearchViewX/Y PROPERTIES (private fields x/y), which are ONLY ever populated by the separate static method ResearchProjectDef.GenerateNonOverlappingCoordinates() (called from PlayDataLoader.ResetStaticDataPre()) - it copies researchViewX/Y into x/y for every def, then nudges apart (+/-0.1 per pass, up to 200 passes) any same-tab pair within (0.5, 0.25) of each other. No 'Couldn't relax research project coordinates apart after 200 passes' line appears in any of the three logs, meaning the algorithm believes it fully resolved every collision on the 596-mod research tree - except apparently this one pair, which still reads as an EXACT match. Why our patched Y=1 does not show up as the source value copied into y is unresolved; two candidate explanations neither confirmed nor ruled out: (a) our PatchOperationSequence's second Replace (researchViewY) silently fails to apply while the first (researchViewX) succeeds - consistent with the observed x matching our patched value while y does not match either the raw (0.5) or our patched value (1); or (b) a hot-reload/companion-tooling load path (JawaBench context lines are present in all three logs) runs ConfigErrorsIfAny without a preceding ResetStaticDataPre, reading stale x/y from an earlier pass. NOT re-attempted blind here, to avoid repeating the exact mistake this investigation already found (a fix committed without a real-load confirmation). RESEARCH_TAB_VIEWCOORD_COLLISION_1 should be reopened with this writeup; the next step is a single bridge-driven full-list load with the dev console open on Research to watch x/y directly, or a debug print inside the patch's own Replace ops.
